rows.grounds: comparative compound indicating conformity with what was previously described
compound denoting worship together with related acts
qualifies the full scope of the rite and its components
names the preparatory ritual procedure being prescribed

items.question: What scope of preliminary rite and worship is prescribed in the same manner as before?
premises: The preliminary rite is the subject being prescribed.
Worship and related acts are included within that rite.
The entire procedure follows the previously described manner.
items.inference: Therefore, the full preliminary rite, beginning with worship and related acts, is prescribed as before.
items.plain_english: All the preliminary rite, beginning with worship and so forth, is prescribed as before.
